claims: National Cheesesteak Day 2026 is on Tuesday, March 24, 2026.
The cheesesteak sandwich was created in 1930 by Pat and Henry Olivieri in Philadelphia.
Cheese was added to the cheesesteak sandwich in 1940.
Penn Station offers $4.99 small cheesesteaks using code STEAK26.
A Guinness World Record attempt in 2026 featured a massive, multi-terminal cheesesteak assembly at the Philadelphia International Airport.
Pat's King of Steaks and Geno's are classic Philadelphia spots
